messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT detected — spike in 5xxs from inference-api (svc=inference, region=us-west-2). Pager sent to @alex and oncall. Auto-attachment: incident-id=INC-2026-03-17-92

alex: seeing it, joining now. how widespread?
rachel: Customer success report: two paying customers reported degraded responses, some requests timing out. not full outage but user-visible latency + errors.
sam: Grafana alert fired: http_5xx_rate > 2% for 3m, source=frontend-proxy. p95 latency also rising ~400ms->1.2s. Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/abcd/inference-overview

maria: quick checks: KV cache hit-rate dropped ~30% in us-west-2, redis metrics show flaps on 3 nodes. could be cache pressure triggering upstream 5xxs.
alex: can we confirm if requests are being routed to fallback model variants? tracing shows a bunch of `model-fallback-v1` spikes.
sam: logs: ``[2026-03-17T21:14:02Z] inference-api | ERROR | upstream 502 on /v1/generate model=falcon-40b`` More context: multiple lb-targets returned 502.
maria: I’m going to scale the inference pool for us-west-2 by +2 nodes (in-progress). will also drain the two noisy redis pods and force-restart.
ops-bot: Action started by maria: scaled group inference-usw2-pool +2; restarted redis-3 pod.
alo: (typo) — ignore
alex: confirmed partial mitigation: 5xx rate dropping to ~1.1% after node add and redis restart. continuing to monitor.
rachel: customers notified via status page; CS team posted templated update. No data exposure.
sam: request: reduce noise of the 5xx alert — it's triggering too often during transient recoveries. propose: change alert from 3m sustained to 6m sustained and add per-model dimension so it only pages on customer-impacting models.
maria: +1. Also propose a new dashboard for retros to capture the incident signals: panels for 5xx rate by model, KV cache hit-rate per region, routing fallbacks count, p95/p99 latency per model, throttle/retry rates, and a small table of top failing backends.
alex: Can someone draft the PromQLs for the proposed panels so we can spin up a Grafana folder and pin them in the postmortem? I'll take the dashboard ownership.
sam: quick drafts: 1) 5xx rate by model: ``sum by (model) (rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-proxy",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum by (model) (rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-proxy"}[5m]))`` 2) p95 latency per model: ``histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference-proxy"}[5m])) by (le,model))`` 3) KV cache hit rate by region: ``sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (region) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total[5m])) by (region)`` 4) routing fallbacks: ``sum(rate(routing_fallback_total[1m])) by (model)``
maria: nice. add panel for throttled requests: ``sum(rate(rate_limited_requests_total[1m])) by (route)`` and a small logs panel with example 502 traces: ``{job="inference-api"} |= "502" | json | line_format "{{.model}} {{.request_id}} {{.error}}"``
rachel: we should include a drilldown link from each panel to the trace in Jaeger and the runbook. propose a small golden-signals row at top: requests, errors(5xx), latency p95, saturation (gpu-util).
alex: I’ll create a dashboard folder: /dashboards/incidents/inference-2026-03-17-mitigation and add those panels. assigning owners: alex (dashboard), sam (alert rule edits), maria (infra followups), rachel (customer comms + postmortem writeup).
sam: alert changes proposed: 1) http_5xx_rate alert: change duration 3m->6m and add label `service_impact="customer-facing"` (only page if matching models in config). 2) Add a noisy-alert suppression window for rolling restarts of cache nodes. I’ll open a PR to monitoring repo.
maria: infra followups: investigate Redis eviction churn, add PodDisruptionBudget on redis sets, and add more KV cache capacity. I’ll file infra tickets.
ops-bot: PR opened by sam: github.com/redwood/monitoring/pull/842 — update 5xx alert thresholds and add suppression rule.
alex: timeline note for postmortem: incident started 2026-03-17T21:12Z, mitigation (scale + restart) at 21:18Z, errors down to baseline at 21:26Z. include customer impact notes from rachel.
rachel: CS added two customers affected, both had retries automated and were restored without manual data fixes. tagging customers in postmortem with risk notes.
sam: quick verification after changes: alert flapping reduced in last 45m on canary cluster. will keep PR open for review.
alex: thanks all. can we schedule a 30min retro tomorrow to review dashboard panels & finalize alert wording?
maria: yes, +1. I’ll include infra owners.
rachel: I’ll draft the postmortem now and link dashboard + PRs.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-03-17-92 resolved (status: mitigated). Retrospective meeting scheduled: 2026-03-18 15:00 PDT.
__notes: Generated synthetic Slack thread for eng-oncall. Contains messages and simple PromQL snippets. All fields are strings or list of strings per agents.md.
